summary: Banco Santander filed a 6-K reporting board approval of an interim cash dividend against 2026 results of 12.7 euro cents per share, roughly 25% of first-half 2026 group underlying profit, consistent with its ordinary policy targeting about 50% of underlying profit split evenly between cash dividends and buybacks. Payment is 2 November 2026; last trade with rights 28 October, ex-dividend 29 October, record 30 October 2026. This complements the buyback announced 10 August and started 24 August 2026. Watch regulatory approvals and further buyback tranches.
